title: Florida SR-26 Wildfire Candidate Replay
description: Source-backed Sentinel Hub close look for the April 15, 2026 SR-26/Balu Forest wildfire east of Gainesville.
task_text: Review the SR-26/Balu Forest wildfire near Gainesville, Florida for candidate smoke, burn-scar, vegetation stress, road corridor context, and fireline review. Keep claims candidate-only unless source-backed imagery supports them.
summary: A real Sentinel-2 L2A SWIR/NIR/Red burn-scar replay seeded from sh.txt credentials. The baseline, prefire, and active-fire windows passed QC; the postfire window was rejected for cloud/valid-pixel quality and is preserved in metadata.

alerts.timelapse_analysis: The Sentinel-2 SWIR/NIR/Red sequence compares the April 1-4 baseline, April 5-14 prefire window, and April 16-18 active-fire window over the SR-26/Balu Forest incident area. The later April 19-May 5 window was rejected for insufficient valid pixels, so the replay remains candidate evidence rather than a postfire confirmation.
alerts.analysis_summary: The Florida firewatch replay is useful for show-and-review because it contains source-backed Sentinel frames from the incident area and keeps uncertainty visible.
alerts.satellite_note: Satellite Pruner retained a candidate fireline packet from the real Sentinel Hub cache.
alerts.ground_note: Ground Validator should present this as candidate wildfire evidence and preserve the rejected postfire-window quality metadata.
alerts.ground_action: REVIEW — Florida SR-26 fireline candidate is replay-ready, but needs a later accepted postfire pass before stronger burn-scar claims.
findings: Real Sentinel Hub Process API frames were cached from sh.txt credentials
